Class Parameter<T>

java.lang.Object
com.kamikazejam.kamicommon.command.Parameter<T>
public class Parameter<T> extends Object
One declared argument of a KamiCommand, pairing a Type with a display name and an optional default value. Build one with of(Type) and the fluent builder; a parameter is required exactly when no default was supplied, and a default of null is legal and different from having none. KamiCommand.addParameter(Parameter) enforces ordering, throwing IllegalArgumentException for a required parameter declared after an optional one and IllegalStateException for anything declared after a concatenating one.
